vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-90711
vulnerability.description: proxy-addr is a Node.js module that determines a request's client addr ...

statements.impact_statement: Transitive dep of express ^5.1.0 in backend. Bumped proxy-addr 2.0.7 -> 2.0.8 via `npm update proxy-addr` in backend/ (patch bump; backend/package-lock.json only). Backend test suite, lint, build, and backend tsc --noEmit all passed.

vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-93749
vulnerability.description: source-map-js: source-map-js: Denial of Service via malformed indexed source maps

statements.impact_statement: Transitive dep of postcss in backend and frontend. Bumped source-map-js 1.2.1 -> 1.2.2 via `npm update source-map-js` in backend/ and frontend/ (patch bump). Backend tests, lint, build, and backend tsc --noEmit all passed; frontend lockfile change is isolated to source-map-js version + benign libc-metadata normalization.
